  "task": "Store, generate, and audit credentials across all platforms",
  "benefits": [
    "Provides open-source and secure password management",
    "Offers flexibility with self-hosting for data control",
    "Simplifies login with built-in 2FA in the Premium tier",
    "Allows cross-device use with no device limits and seamless syncing"
  ],
  "frictions": [
    "Has clunky or inconsistent autofill, especially on modern web applications",
    "Sometimes fails to detect fields automatically, requiring manual triggers",
    "Features a utilitarian user interface that prioritizes utility over visual polish",
    "Lacks fluid animations, clean typography, and intuitive categorization in its design"
  ]
}
